In 10 years:

- Alice will be \(2b + 10\)
- Bob will be \(b + 10\)

\[
2b + 10 = 1.5(b + 10)
\]

\[
2b + 10 = 1.5b + 15
\]

\[
0.5b = 5
\]

\[
b = 10
\]

ANSWER: 10
